market_name: Will no Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Confirm the direction of the implied-probability shift and check 2y/10y Treasury yield ticks and fed funds futures (SOFR strip) for corroboration.
time_plan.1h: Check whether any Fedspeak, CPI/PCE, or jobs data explains the move; distinguish genuine leak from noise.
time_plan.2h: Reassess TLT move vs. yield move; verify move is not already fully public/priced.
time_plan.6h: Look for follow-through in rates and whether equities/dollar confirm the hawkish/dovish read.
time_plan.12h: Compare realized TLT return to expected; log whether the prediction-market move led or lagged the bond move.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp rise in the implied probability that the Fed makes NO cuts in 2026 is a hawkish repricing of the front end and terminal rate. Higher-for-longer expectations push yields up across the curve; long-duration bond prices fall. TLT is the most rate-sensitive liquid proxy. If instead the 'no cuts' probability falls (dovish), TLT would rally — direction is conditional on the sign of the market move.

predictions.tradable_instrument_name: Invesco DB US Dollar Index Bullish Fund

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Confirm direction of probability shift; check DXY, EURUSD, USDJPY intraday for confirmation.
time_plan.1h: Screen for competing drivers (other central banks, risk sentiment) that could dominate USD.
time_plan.2h: Check whether dollar move aligns with the rates move; downgrade if divergent.
time_plan.6h: Reassess follow-through and whether the catalyst has gone public.
time_plan.12h: Compare realized UUP return to expected; note lead/lag vs prediction market.

predictions.reasoning: Hawkish repricing (higher odds of no 2026 cuts) widens US rate differentials and tends to support the dollar. UUP is a liquid DXY proxy. Move is conditional: a dovish shift (falling 'no cuts' odds) would weaken the dollar. FX reaction to a rate-path repricing is typically smaller and noisier than the bond reaction.

evidence_used: Market resolves on number of 25bp Fed cuts in 2026 per FOMC statements
'No cuts' probability is a direct read on the hawkish/dovish rate path
Standard transmission: hawkish rate path -> higher yields, lower long bonds, stronger USD, softer equities
uncertainty_notes: Direction is entirely conditional on the SIGN of the implied-probability move, which is not specified here
2026 cuts are a distant horizon; a probability move may reflect slow drift rather than a discrete news catalyst
12h window is short; macro proxies driven by many competing forces
700bps tradability threshold is far above realistic 12h moves in these liquid macro proxies, so neither prediction qualifies as tradable

llm_justification.summary: This market is a direct barometer of the 2026 Fed rate path. A sharp increase in the probability of NO cuts is a hawkish signal implying higher yields (TLT down) and a firmer dollar (UUP up); a decrease implies the opposite. The mapping to liquid rate/FX proxies is mechanically clean, but 12h magnitudes are modest and well below the 700bps tradability bar, and the sign depends on which way the market moved.
key_assumptions: A sharp move in this market reflects a genuine shift in Fed-path expectations rather than thin-market noise
Standard rate-transmission relationships hold over the 12h window
The move is not already fully reflected in Treasury/FX markets
failure_modes: Direction reverses because the probability move was a fade of an overreaction
Information was already public (post-CPI/FOMC) and priced into bonds/FX before the prediction market
Distant 2026 horizon means little immediate impact on front-end-sensitive proxies
Competing macro drivers (other central banks, risk-off flows) dominate the dollar and long bonds, swamping the rate-path signal
Prediction market illiquidity produces a phantom probability move with no informational content
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
